title: Ministry of National Defence
excerpt: Romanian Ministry of National Defence. It contains news from MoND, the structure of the ministry, the military forces
content_html:
No. 150 27.07.2026

Press Information

Following the attacks conducted on Sunday, July 26th, by the Russian Federation against the civilian and infrastructure targets in Ukraine, near the river border with Romania, the radar surveillance system of the Ministry of National Defence detected an aerial target at 09:29, approximately 25 km southeast of Sulina.

No. 150 27.07.2026

新闻资讯

7月26日星期日，俄罗斯联邦对乌克兰境内靠近罗马尼亚河流边界的民用和基础设施目标发动袭击后，国防部雷达监视系统于09时29分在苏利纳东南约25公里处发现了一个空中目标。
